properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Application Insights: Must Use Workspace-Based Mode
properties.description: Audits Application Insights components that are not workspace-based (classic mode). FedRAMP High AU-6 requires centralized audit review, analysis, and reporting. Workspace-based Application Insights forwards all telemetry to a Log Analytics workspace, enabling cross-service correlation, unified retention policies, and centralized access control. Classic Application Insights uses isolated storage that cannot be queried alongside other audit data.

metadata.description: Audit: Report classic (non-workspace-based) Application Insights components. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
